summary.text: Phil Amato is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 113 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A manufacturer's sales representative, he is vice chair of the Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Amato graduated from Jennings High School in 1972 and earned an associate degree in sales and business from St. Louis Community College at Meramec in 1984.
His career experience includes working as a manufacturer's sales representative.
For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Local Government Committee, where he was vice chair, and the House Economic Development Committee.
